chapters.title: One day a little girl named…
p: One day a little girl named Raya was in her preschool classroom. She saw her teacher in front of the blackboard. Raya was so excited to see what she was going to learn!
The teacher said, "Today we are going to talk about how deep the ocean is. Can everyone stand up?"
Raya stood up along with all of her friends. The teacher started to draw on the blackboard to explain how deep the ocean is. She drew a long line across the board and said, "The ocean is so deep!"
Raya was so amazed by how deep the ocean was. She could hardly believe it. She asked her teacher, "Is the ocean really deep?"
The teacher smiled and nodded her head. "The ocean is really a deep and fascinating place," she said. "It's like a whole other world."
Raya couldn't wait to explore the ocean and all its secrets. She smiled, realizing just how much she had learned today.

chapters.title: Once there was a man and…
p: Once there was a man and a woman who lived by the harbor. Each day they watched boats come and go and wished they could go too.
One day, they decided to push their own boat into the water. It was an old purple boat, but they knew it was strong enough to sail. So they pushed it into the harbor.
The man and woman sailed around the harbor until it got dark. But, as soon as it got dark, the wind started to push them away from the harbor. They couldn't get back in!
The man and woman sailed around the harbor all night, but they couldn't find a way back in. By morning, they were so far away from the harbor that it seemed like it was just a speck on the horizon.

The man and woman were never able to come back to the harbor. They were lost at sea for weeks, until finally their boat drifted onto a shore far away from the harbor. Unfortunately, it was a bad ending for the man and woman.

chapters.title: It was a sunny day and…
p: It was a sunny day, and Melissa wanted to walk to the park. She grabbed her phone, and asked her Mom "Can I go to the park, Mom?"
Mom said "Yes, honey, but you must promise me to stay at the park. No walking away onto other streets, okay?" Melissa nodded, and said "Yes, I promise".
Mom gave Melissa a telephone. "This is in case you ever need me while you are at the park." She told her. "If you need me, just call me right away!"
Melissa thanked her and went to the park. Once she was there, she noticed something weird. There was a big bear walking around! She watched it for a few minutes, until it disappeared out of sight.
Melissa smiled, happy to have made it to the park safely. She reminded herself of her promise to her Mom, and went to play.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there were…
p: Once upon a time there were two best friends, named Brandy and Kris. They loved to play together. One day, they decided to have a game of hide and seek. Brandy was the seeker. She closed her eyes and counted to ten while Kris quickly found a hiding spot behind the purple sofa.

When Brandy was done counting, she looked around but couldn't find her friend. Suddenly, she heard a giggle in the corner. She looked to the sofa and saw a pair of purple shoes sticking out! She knew it was Kris.

She started to walk over to grab Kris, but something caught her attention. There was a small purple player laying on the floor. She had never seen that before. Brandy absent-mindedly picked up the player before she continued to go after Kris.

But it was too late! She had slipped up and Kris heard her. Kris jumped out from behind the sofa and ran away. Brandy chased her for a bit before giving up. She returned to the purple player and decided to take it home with her. From then on, she and Kris always loved playing with the purple player.

chapters.title: Once there was a boy His…
p: Once there was a boy. His name was Tom. Tom was very weird. One day he spotted a knot on the ground. He bent down and slapped it. The knot started to move! Tom was so surprised. He couldn't believe it. He had never seen anything so weird. The knot kept bouncing around the room, slapping things, and making a lot of noise. Tom didn't know what to do. Just then, his mom came in the room. She saw Tom and the weird knot and quickly made it stop moving! Tom's mom was so relieved. She was glad Tom knew better than to slap strange knots.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a small lion named Felix. He was very brave and could scare anyone who made him angry. Every day, he would walk into the wilderness in search of adventure.
One day, Felix came across a tiny inchworm on the side of the path.
The worm looked very sad and Felix wanted to help it. He asked the worm why it was so sad, but it just shrugged its shoulders.
Felix tried to make the worm feel better by talking to it and offering it small treats. Nothing seemed to work and the small worm kept shrugging.
Finally, Felix decided to pick up the inchworm and carry it into the nearby forest. He would carry it all the way home, where it could be safe and happy.
Unfortunately, the journey was too much for the inchworm. By the time Felix made it home, the inchworm had died. Felix was heartbroken and he felt so sad.
The end.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a polar bear who was very weak. He wanted to build an igloo, but he was too weak to build it by himself. So he asked his closest friends for help. Everyone wanted to help him, but the polar bear was so weak that he could not even lift his paw.
He was so sad that it seemed like he would never find a way to build his igloo. But then an idea came to him. He was going to ask other animals who were strong and brave.
So the polar bear hoped and dreamed that the other animals would help him. He asked the fox, the owl, and the walrus. They all said yes to help him and together they started building his igloo.
The moral of this story is that if you hope and believe, anything is possible, even the impossible. You just need to keep asking for help and you will get it!

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a pink garden. It was filled with different kinds of pretty flowers and green grass. Every day the garden was filled with lots of happy noises from different critters that lived there.

One day a little girl heard a noise from the garden. She was so curious that she decided to take a look and see what was making the noise. As she peeked outside the garden she saw a big pink car driving very fast. It was the most beautiful car she had ever seen.

The little girl was so excited that she ran to the garden to tell all the critters about it. She ran as fast as she could, but the car was already gone. She was so sad that she missed it. But then suddenly, the same pink car sped back past the garden. This time with a nice old man driving it. He waved and smiled at the little girl as he drove.

The little girl was so happy that she waved and ran through the garden, telling all the critters about her exciting day. She had seen a beautiful pink car speed past the garden and the old man had even waved at her.
From that day forward, the little girl always looked for the pink car to come back. But it never did.

chapters.title: Max and Ruth were walking one…
p: Max and Ruth were walking one morning through a distant field. The sun shone brightly, and the air smelled sweet.
Suddenly, Max stumbled. Ruth looked at him and said, "Are you okay?"
Max rubbed his knee and shook his head. He had bumped it!
Ruth smiled and said, "Let's go find a special rock. We can put it on your knee and it'll make it feel better!"
Max looked up at her, hopeful.
The two wandered together, looking for the perfect rock. Ruth finally found one near a clump of bushes. Max put it on his knee, and the pain began to fade away. He smiled.
Ruth smiled back. "See, what did I tell you?"
Max hugged her, thankful for her help. He was so glad that his best friend had been there when he stumbled.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She had a chair in her bedroom which was very comfortable for her. Every day after lunch, she liked to take a nap in her chair.
The little girl was always hungry, and so she was excited when her mommy said it was time for dinner. She put on her yummy clothes and imagined what dinner would taste like.
When the little girl's dinner was ready, she sat in her chair and ate it. The dinner was so yummy, she barely had enough room for dessert.
When dinner was done, the little girl was very tired. She climbed into the chair and went to sleep.
The little girl had a wonderful nap and when she woke, she felt like she had enough energy to play all day.
The end.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was an adventurous goose. She wanted to go on an adventure, but she had no idea where to go. Then one day, she heard some loud clapping. It was so loud that she could hear it from far away. She wondered what it was and flew towards the clapping.

When she arrived, she saw a big crowd of people. Everyone was clapping and smiling, as if they were having fun. She was so curious that she had to get closer. As she flew down to the crowd, everyone stopped clapping and started to applaud the goose!

The goose was so surprised and happy. She had never expected her adventure to end up with so much appreciation! She flapped her wings and thanked everyone with a loud honk and continued her journey with a newfound joy.

chapters.title: One day there was a bad…
p: One day, there was a bad man. He was a terrible man. He liked to steal things, like sunglasses. He crept into the house of a nice man and tried to steal his sunglasses.
But the nice man saw the bad man, and he was very angry. He shouted, "No! You must not steal!" The bad man was very scared and he ran away. He was very sad and he felt bad.
The nice man was happy. He was glad that the bad man had not stolen his sunglasses. He put them back on his head and enjoyed the sunshine. He was very glad that the bad man had not been successful.

chapters.title: One day Bob and his sister…
p: One day, Bob and his sister Sally decided to go for a ride. As they headed outside, they saw their mom discussing something with their dad. The conversation seemed serious.
"What are they discussing?", asked Sally.
Bob looked alert as he answered, "I think they're talking about the motor in the car."

So Bob and Sally decided to have a look. When they reached the car, they saw a big motor inside! It was shiny and brightly coloured. Bob and Sally were very curious and asked their parents a lot of questions about the motor.
Mom and dad were very happy to explain everything to the children and told them all about how the motor worked.
Bob and Sally were very pleased to learn all about the motor and thanked their parents before heading back inside to play.

chapters.title: Bob was walking through the big…
p: Bob was walking through the big park. He felt something tickle his nose. He stopped, and tried to stop himself from sneezing. He held his breath and pinched his nose, but it was no use. He let out a big "ACHOO!"
"Bless you!" said a voice.
Bob looked up and saw a girl standing nearby. She was wearing a pink dress and had pigtails. She smiled and waved at Bob.
"Are you okay?" she asked.
Bob nodded. "I'm okay," he said. "I just sneezed."
The girl giggled. "That's okay. I sneezed too, a minute ago. I'm Bertha."
Bertha and Bob sat down on a bench. Bob put his arm around Bertha's shoulder, and she leaned against him. They watched a lazy dog sleeping in the grass.
"That dog sure is lazy," said Bertha. "He must've been playing in the park all day."
Bob smiled. "Let's go play too," he said. And off they went, having fun in the sunshine.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a reliable chef named Chef Joe. Every night he cooked a delicious meal for his family. Tonight, he was cooking something special with avocado.
The family gathered around the dinner table, ready to give it a try. Little Hermione was especially excited to see what Chef Joe had cooked up. She asked, 'What is it?'
Chef Joe smiled and said, 'Can you guess?' Little Hermione thought about it for a moment. Suddenly, she figured it out and exclaimed, 'It's guacamole!'
Chef Joe nodded and said, 'That's right! I made guacamole with avocado.' Little Hermione smiled and took a big bite. It was delicious!
Chef Joe's family was very proud of him. They could always count on him to cook a reliable and delicious meal.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a little girl named Jane. Jane woke up one day and she was very dry. She wanted to stir something up to make it a bit more interesting. So she thought of an idea! She went to tell the news to her mom.
When she found her mom she said, "Mom, I have news!" Her mom said, "What is it, Jane?" Jane said, "I want to stir something up and make it more fun!"
Her mom said, "What do you want to stir?" Jane said, "Let's make some cake! We can stir the flour and eggs and make something yummy!"
Her mom smiled and said, "That sounds like a great idea, Jane!" They both went to the kitchen and stirred all of the dry ingredients until they had a big, delicious cake ready.
The end.

chapters.title: One day William was very excited…
p: One day, William was very excited because he was going to the park with his mum. When he got there, he noticed a big machine with lots of colourful buttons on it. He thought it was a fan! William asked his mum what it was and she told him it was called an examine machine.

She said, "Let's take a closer look." So they walked towards the examine machine and they saw lots of lights and sounds. William was so excited he started pressing all the buttons. His mum was a bit worried, but she knew he was curious.
Suddenly, the examine machine started spinning and making a loud noise. William jumped backwards and shouted, "What's happening?" His mum just laughed and said, "It's just a fan, William! It's ok."

William smiled and ran up to the fan. He started touching it and feeling its wind on his face. It felt so nice! From then on every time William went to the park he was so excited to see the examine machine and the fan.
The End

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She had a good friend and they loved to play together.
One day, they decided to pretend. The little girl got a peach and said, "Let's pretend this peach is our pet!"
Her friend smiled and said, "Good idea!" They pretended the peach was a puppy and that it liked to go for walks. They laughed and played with the peach. Pretending was so much fun.
After a few hours, the friends stopped pretending and enjoyed their real pet- a sweet little cat. They held and petted the cat, giving it lots of love.
The little girl and her friend had a very good day of play, both pretending and in real life.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there were…
p: Once upon a time, there were two friends named Frankie and Mary. They loved to race each other. Frankie had a number, five, and Mary had a number, one.
But before they could race, they had to be very quiet. They tiptoed to where they wanted to race and stopped in a quiet spot. They had to be extra quiet because there were other people around.

After they had been quiet for a long time, it was time for them to race. Frankie counted to three and started running. Mary counted to five, then started running. They raced and raced until they reached the finish line.
Frankie had won! He was so happy that he jumped for joy and gave Mary a big hug. They both smiled and laughed. After that, they raced each other again and again!

chapters.title: Once there was a great man…
p: Once there was a great man called Tom. Tom loved to go fishing. Every day he would take his rod to the beach and stand by the sea. He waited for the fish to come by. One day, he saw a big fish swimming in the water. It was too far away, so he decided to dive in and try and catch it.

Tom took a deep breath and then dived! In and out of the water he went, until eventually he was able to grab hold of the fish. It was a great catch! He quickly put it in his basket and then walked back to shore.
Tom was delighted and wanted to show everyone his great catch. He asked his friends and family to come to the beach and they clapped and cheered when they saw the big fish!
Tom was very proud of his rod. He had done a great job catching the fish, and he was ready to dive again tomorrow.

chapters.title: Once there was a little boy…
p: Once there was a little boy called Toby. He loved to go on nature walks. One day he went to the shore with his mommy. He saw something that made him very happy. It was a cute little boat! Toby demanded that his mommy take him for a ride in the boat.

They got in the boat and putted off to the middle of the sea. Toby looked all around and saw many fish swimming near the shore. They were so colourful and Toby thought they were so cute. As the boat continued to sail, Toby felt the breeze on his face. He loved feeling the wind blow against him.

When they finally reached the edge of the shore they got out of the boat. Toby was so happy he had gone on a boat ride with his mommy. He shouted in joy as he ran some more nature walks along the shore. He had a great day with his mommy, and he couldn't wait to do it all again!

chapters.title: One day a boy saw a…
p: One day, a boy saw a purple bird outside. The boy was excited, so he wanted to dive closer. He walked outside and found a twig on the ground. He picked up the twig and flew it in the air. The purple bird saw the twig and started to dive up and down around it. The boy was laughing so much that he was rolling around on the ground. The bird flew away and the boy was sad, but he still had the twig in his hands. He ran back inside his house and kept the twig as a special reminder.

chapters.title: Once upon a time in a…
p: Once upon a time, in a meadow deep in the woods, there was a wolf. Every day, the wolf would march around the meadow, always in the same path. He was a reliable animal, that the other creatures in the forest trusted.

One day, a little 3 year old girl was walking in the woods with her parents. When she saw the wolf marching around the meadow, the little girl asked her parents: "What's that?". Her parents told her that it was a wolf. The little girl smiled, and the parents told their daughter to march just like the wolf.

So the little girl put her hands on her hips, and began to march around the meadow, just like the wolf! She marched happily, and the wolf stopped to watch her. After a short while, the little girl stopped marching and hugged the wolf, who was very reliable. The wolf licked the little girl's face, and they both smiled. Together they ran back to the little girl's family and waved goodbye to the wolf.

chapters.title: Once there was a turkey It…
p: Once there was a turkey. It was a big turkey and it liked to strut around in the meadow. One day it was walking around in the grass and it felt something pinch it. The turkey looked down and saw that it's leg was broken. The turkey was so sad.

The next day, the turkey hopped around to try and find help. It hopped to a farmer's house and asked for help. The farmer took a look and said he could fix it. He put some magic glue on the broken leg and soon it was fixed.
The turkey was so happy. It thanked the farmer and then hopped away. It was so happy that it couldn't stop singing! It went around the meadow, singing happily and nothing ever pinched it again.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a boy named Jack. One day Jack wanted to go for a run in the park, so he asked his mom for some shoes. His mom said yes and gave him a pair of red shoes with white laces. They had an attractive red bow on top.
Jack was excited, so he quickly put on the shoes. But when he tried to tie them, he couldn't make a knot. He thought and thought, but he just couldn't figure out how to do it.
So Jack made a request - he asked his mom for help. His mom smiled and took the laces from him. She showed him how to make a knot, then she tied the laces nicely together.
Jack thanked his mom and he ran off to enjoy his time in the park. He was so happy that his mom had helped him with his request.
